summary: Tested shore contact phone numbers and the background distress SMS sent through Twilio. Only the unassigned number +9991234567 was used; Twilio refused it with error 21211. Backend: 16 of 16 pytest tests passed, plus a manual check that the daily limit of 30 SMS per user returns 429. Frontend (390x844, admin's own boat with only invited contacts that have phones, and crew test_session_free_1 on pro/main): the phone field, its note, the invalid-phone toast, Add phone > input > Save, the phone shown on contact rows, MAYDAY Confirm (line hides, POST /distress-sms fires, polling stops after one GET with status failed, no tick, no toast, no spinner, no dialog, list stays usable), PAN-PAN Ignore, and crew Confirm sending owner_id=test-user-pro all worked. One bug: the count of shore contact phones is fetched only once, so a phone added in the same session is not texted when Confirm is pressed.

minor.issue: Twilio SDK logs every request and response at INFO level in backend.err.log, including the Account SID in the URL. Set logging.getLogger('twilio.http_client').setLevel(logging.WARNING).
Expired shore invites (expires_at in the past) are still texted. This may be intended ('still invited'), but it isn't filtered.

ui_bugs.issue: GET /distress-sms/phones runs only when [online, owner, boatId] change. If a skipper adds a phone (new invite or Add phone) and then presses MAYDAY Confirm in the same session, canSend is false and no POST /distress-sms is made until the page is reloaded. Reproduced: admin invited TEST_Stale with +9991234567, closed the Crew window, opened MAYDAY and pressed Confirm. Only POST /distress-email fired. Fix: refetch phones when the MAYDAY or PAN-PAN list opens (or when ShoreContacts saves), or have the backend decide (always POST and let it return count 0).

design_issues.screen: Crew window > Shore Contacts invite form (390px)
issues: The shore-invite-phone placeholder 'Their mobile, e.g. +64 21 555 1234 (optional)' is cut off at '(op'. Shorten it, e.g. 'Mobile, e.g. +64 21 555 1234'.

action_items: Refresh the shore-phone count in useDistressSms when the MAYDAY or PAN-PAN list opens or after a phone or invite is saved, so a newly added phone is texted without a reload
Set the twilio.http_client logger to WARNING
Optional: shorten the phone placeholder on mobile; decide whether expired invites should get the SMS
critical_code_review_comments: The TWILIO_* keys are not in backend/.env; they come only from the pod environment. Make sure production/deploy gets them, otherwise /distress-sms/phones quietly returns 0 and nothing is sent.
The _send_all background tasks live only in process memory. A backend reload mid-send leaves the doc stuck at 'sending'. Harmless to the UI (no tick, polling stops after 40 tries) but worth knowing.
The daily limit is checked only after phones are found, and it counts per user across all boats. Fine.
Status logic: if any message is delivered and all are final, the status is 'delivered' and the tick reads 'N of M'. Matches the brief.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Removed: all TEST shore invites on admin/main, 4 distress_sms docs I created (plus 29 temporary limit-test docs), 2 distress_emails docs from admin's Confirm. Restored: admin/main boat.shore_email='' and shore_name='' (invites auto-fill it); pro/main distress and tracking from a snapshot (crew Confirm had raised an active mayDay alert); test-shore-only phone cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use admin (test_session_admin_1) own main for SMS UI tests; it has no joined contacts. On load press Escape, then the 'Not now' button on the Trip finished dialog. Inviting a shore contact auto-fills boat.shore_email, so reset it in the DB afterwards. Crew: test_session_free_1, boat-selector > boat-option-c_test-user-pro_main. Snapshot pro/main distress and tracking before any Confirm and restore them afterwards. Run pytest with -n 0 (the tests depend on order).
rca of the issue: useDistressSms.js loads `phones` once in a useEffect keyed on online/owner/boatId. canSend(kind) needs phones > 0, so contacts or phones added later in the session are invisible until boatId changes or the page reloads.
